THE ENTIRE SPAN OF HUMAN HISTORY IS IN YOUR HANDS, IN THIS “GAME OF THE YEAR” WINNING FRANCHISE

The Extended Edition Includes:
  - Rise of Nations Original 
  - Rise of Nations: Thrones and Patriots – The Expansion for the PC Game of the Year

Join the over 2 million Rise of Nations fans. Master 6,000 years of history, from the Ancient Age to the Information Age. What forces will you wield to lead your nation to global prominence? Trade, espionage, diplomacy…war? Whichever path you choose, you’ll discover the pulse-pounding thrill and speed of real-time strategy gaming combined with the epic scope and depth of turn-based strategy games – brought together for the first time ever in Rise of Nations.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Join the over 2 million Rise of Nations fans. Master 6,000 years of history, from the Ancient Age to the Information Age. What forces will you wield to lead your nation to global prominence? Trade, espionage, diplomacy…war? Properties.PublisherCertificateName: CN=Microsoft Corporation, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US

Features: Lead one of 24 Nations each with its own distinctive attributes and special units.
Learn to Play with 6 tutorials for beginning to experienced strategy gamers.
Take command over a hundred military units operating on the ground, sea, and air— from Hoplites to Frigates to Helicopters.
Research more than 50 technologies over 8 historical epochs.
Build Wonders of the World—including the Terra Cotta Army, the Taj Mahal, the Eiffel Tower. Each gives your nation special bonuses.
Play a variety of Single-Player campaigns including, Alexander the Great, The New World, Napoleon and the Cold War.
Experience more than a dozen map types in single and multiplayer scenarios, ranging from the Amazon Rainforest to the Himalayas to the Nile Delta.
Discover the critically-acclaimed Conquer the World campaign.
Play your way – get engaged for hours or in short sessions.
Multiplayer:  Challenge up to 8 players online
Improved visuals:  Improved water, Improved textures, Full-screen anti-aliasing
